title: Is This NEW United 737 MAX Mission Pack Worth Your Money? (MSFS 2024)
description:
The weekly Microsoft Flight Simulator Marketplace update is here, and this time we are diving deep into two major milestone activity packs from Perfect Flight built to take your commercial pilot career to the next level in MSFS 2024.

First up, we are tackling a massive airline itinerary with the "12 Legs United Springs 2026" pack. Designed natively around the default MSFS 2024 Boeing 737 MAX 8 in the iconic United livery, these 12 ultra-realistic IFR missions mirror real-world United Airlines routing, scheduling, and protocols. From busy domestic networks and transcontinental operations to Gulf Coast transitions and Great Lakes crossings, your cockpit skills will be tested with over 100 dynamic operational challenge events and failures monitored via an interactive EFB companion web app.

But if you’d rather trade standard airline routes for raw stick-and-rudder precision, we are heading down under for the "Advanced Challenges Australia" pack. This bundle features 24 grueling landing challenges across Australia and New Zealand. You will face diverse civil and military airfields piloting everything from STOL aircraft like the Pilatus PC-12 and Diamond DA62, up to heavy widebodies like the Airbus A320, Boeing 737, and the legendary Boeing 747.

In this video, we break down exactly what you get inside these mission browsers, check out the EFB features, and analyze whether they are worth your hard-earned marketplace credits.

✈️ What do you think? Are you planning to pick up these official activity packs from the Marketplace, or will you stick to planning your own routes? Let me know your thoughts in the comment section below!

Don't forget to like, subscribe for weekly simulator updates, and clear skies on your next departure!
